lede: Lumibricks sells brick building sets with LED lights built in, from cyberpunk streets and cafés to log cabins and trains, from lumibricks.com. Here's what it sells, what customers say about it, and whether it's worth the money.

parts: Lumibricks is a real company. Its contact page names Hongkong SusenGo Technology Ltd. with an address in Guangzhou, China, and it ships from its own warehouses in the US, Canada, Germany and the UK. On Trustpilot it held 4.2 out of 5 from 165 reviews when we checked (its own site banner says 4.7). Buyers love how the finished sets look; the complaints are about missing or broken pieces and slow replies from support.

Display sets for adults, with the lighting designed into the build rather than added later: city shops (Book-Cafe, Record Store, Gelato Store, Newsstand), a cyberpunk "Neoncity" line (Izakaya, Game Stack), cabins and cottages (Aurora Cabin), Western scenes (Western Saloon, Western Freight Train), an Apartment and more. The best sellers run from $34.99 to $179.99 and from about 1,500 to 2,600 pieces, with recommended ages of 16+. Lumibricks says its prints are printed on the bricks, with no stickers.

parts: Most recent reviews are 5 stars: fast delivery, clear instructions, detailed builds and lights that make the finished set. Several buyers have ordered again. The low-star reviews are worth reading too: a broken large piece on arrival and a slow replacement, a lamp that came without its power part, a Neon Garden kit the buyer found frustrating, an order that couldn't be cancelled 10 minutes after it was placed, and complaints that support asks for a lot of proof before replacing parts. One 3-star reviewer said the sets look stunning but the build is easy to get wrong.

Yes. lumibricks.com names the company and its address, gives a UK VAT number, publishes its shipping and return policies, and answers at service@lumibricks.com. Orders in the US, Canada, the UK and the EU ship from local warehouses in 3 to 6 business days, which matches what reviewers describe. One thing to note: the 4.7 rating on its banner is higher than the 4.2 Trustpilot showed when we looked.

The lighting is included in the price: the $129.99 Izakaya comes with 20 light points and 8 light strips, so there's no separate light kit to buy. Shipping is free in the US and UK. The risk is a missing or damaged piece, so open and check the bags soon after delivery while you're inside the 30-day return window.
